full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the Rule, in brief, are that on 24-12-1997 at about 5-00 PM the petitioner and co-accused Maksud Hasan alias Revenge were apprehended by informant Abdul Kader and others out of suspicion and searching their body a pipe gun with a bullet from Maksud Hasan and a razor from the petitioner were recovered. On the same day with the arms and ammunition they were handed over to the police. Next day in the morning the informant lodged first information report at Muradnagar PS against them on the allegation of unauthorisedly keeping a pipe gun with a bullet and a razor in their possession. Police after investigation of the case submitted charge-sheet against them, who were put on trial before the Special Tribunal No. 8, Comilla, wherein charges under sections 19A and 19(f) of the Arms Act against them were framed, to which they pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried. Their case is that of innocence and false implication. They being released on bail at one stage of trial remained absent and accordingly trial was held in their absence. The Special Tribunal after recording the evidence adduced by the prosecution and considering the same convicted and sentenced both the accused as aforesaid. The petitioner being arrested on 20-12-2000 moved this Court by filing this application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the judgment and order of conviction and sentence stating, inter alia, that during trial of the case the petitioner, who was on bail, was arrested on 4-4-1999 in connection with Kafrul PS Case No. 9(4) 1999 under section 4 of the Explosive Substance Act and was in custody till acquittal in that case on 30-4-2000, that he was arrested on 20-11-2000 in execution of warrant of arrest issued in the present case, that as in the mean time period of limitation of preferring Appeal under section 30 of the Special Powers Act expired the petitioner filed this application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure and obtained this Rule.
